name: lerobot-v3-to-v2_1
description: Convert an uploaded LeRobot v3.0 dataset into a LeRobot v2.1 dataset. De-aggregates v3.0's consolidated parquet shards back into per-episode parquet files, splits the concatenated per-camera video shards into per-episode MP4s (lossless, frame-exact), and rewrites metadata into the v2.1 schema (info.json, tasks.jsonl, episodes.jsonl, episodes_stats.jsonl). The source dataset is read-only; by default the action creates a new dataset (name inherited from the source) for the v2.1 output and stamps provenance metadata linking back to the source.

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: Optional. If set, upload the converted v2.1 dataset into this existing Roboto dataset instead of creating a new one. By default the action creates a new dataset whose name is derived from the source dataset ("<source name> (LeRobot v2.1)") and stamps provenance metadata pointing back to the source.
